story.title: From China Market to Global Success
story.subtitle: 15 Years of Bridging China's Manufacturing Hub with Global Businesses
story.hqSubtitle: Direct access to the world's largest wholesale market
story.paragraph1: Founded in 2011 with boots on the ground in China, we recognized that the world's largest wholesale market needed a bridge to global businesses. What started as a local sourcing partnership has evolved into the most trusted gateway for international companies seeking quality, speed, and transparency in China trade.
story.paragraph2: Today, we combine deep China market relationships with modern logistics technology, in-house quality control, and transparent pricing. From Silicon Valley startups to Fortune 500 companies, we've proven that China sourcing doesn't have to be complicated, risky, or opaque.
story.setsApartBody: While others offer generic sourcing services, we provide exclusive China market access with transparent pricing, real-time quality control, and express logistics networks that deliver 40% faster than industry average.

process.step5Desc: Your products arrive safely with ongoing support for any issues or reorders.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How we collect, use, and protect your personal information.
privacy.p1: We collect information you provide directly (name, email, company, shipping and billing details) when you create an account, request a quote, or place an order. We also collect limited technical data such as device type and usage analytics to improve our platform.
privacy.p2: Your information is used to process orders, provide logistics and customs support, respond to inquiries, and send service-related communications. We do not sell your personal data to third parties.
privacy.p3: We apply industry-standard encryption and access controls to protect your data in transit and at rest. Payment processing is handled by PCI-compliant providers; we never store full card numbers on our servers.
privacy.p4: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data at any time by contacting our support team. We will respond within the timeframe required by applicable law.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.description: The terms and conditions governing your use of our platform.
terms.p1: By accessing or using our platform, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service and our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, please do not use the service.
terms.p2: We provide sourcing, consolidation, quality inspection, and international logistics services connecting buyers with manufacturers. We act as an intermediary and do not manufacture products ourselves.
terms.p3: Quotes are valid for the period stated. Orders are confirmed upon payment. Pricing, lead times, and shipping estimates are provided in good faith and may vary with market conditions.
terms.p4: Our liability is limited to the value of the services rendered. We are not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the use of the platform.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.description: How and why we use cookies on our platform.
cookies.p1: Cookies are small text files stored on your device that help us remember your preferences and understand how you use our platform.
cookies.p2: We use essential cookies to keep you logged in and secure, and analytics cookies to improve performance. We do not use cookies to sell your personal data.
cookies.p3: You can control or delete cookies through your browser settings at any time. Disabling essential cookies may affect core functionality such as checkout and order tracking.
cookies.p4a: Questions about our use of cookies? Email
